items.name: Home Assistant Core

current.source: lab Home Assistant, recorded in services/schedule_policy.py (verified 2026-09-30); the live value is ha_sync.STATE.ha_version / health report; the release package matrix still says 2026.9.2

items.note: Monthly releases (first Wednesday-ish) plus weekly patches. We use the WebSocket API (auth, get_states, registries, subscribe_events, auth/current_user, refresh tokens), the REST API (/api/states, /api/services, history), long-lived access tokens, the bridge custom integration (config flow, services, hassio discovery) and entity/area/floor/device registries. The checker parses the 'Backward-incompatible changes' headings of the release notes and the beta notes and matches them against every item's ha_domains.
